figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Discovery and functional characterization of TmT1βH and Tm576. A) Phylogenetic analysis of α-KG-dependent dioxygenase family genes in
Taxus × media cell cultures. The phylogenetic trees were constructed using the neighbor-joining method in Mega with 1000 bootstrap replicates. B)
Functional characterization of TmT1βH and Tm576. (i) Enzymatic conversion of 1 to bacatin IV (1a) and 15-hydroxy-11(15→1)abeo-baccatin IV (1b) by
TmT1βH and 1 to 1b by Tm576 in tobacco leaves; (ii) HPLC chromatograms (227 nm) of extracts from N. benthamiana leaves with transient
expression of (a) TmT1βH + 1, (b) Tm576 +1, and (c) empty vector (EV) +1; HPLC analysis (227 nm) of the products derived from (d) mutated R96A
of TmT1βH enzyme activity (puriﬁed protein from recombinant E. coli) and (e) wild type TmT1βH enzyme activity (puriﬁed protein from recombinant
E. coli) against 1 in vitro assays in the same reaction conditions.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Exploring the substrate scope of TmT1βH. A) The chemical structures of substrates used to explore for substrate scope of TmT1βH. B)
HPLC chromatograms (227 nm) of extracts from N. benthamiana leaves with transient expression of (a) TmT1βH + 2, (b) TmCYP1 (TOT)+2, (c)
TmT1βH+1; (d) TmCYP1+2a; (e) both enzyme (TmT1βH+TmCYP1)+2 and (f) empty vector (EV)+2. C) The speciﬁc catalytic orders and substrate
promiscuities of taxane C1β-hydroxylase (TmT1βH) and TOT (TmCYP1), contributing to the metabolic network of late paclitaxel pathway. The thick
arrows represent the predominant pathways.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Heterologous reconstitution of baccatin IV (1a) and baccatin VI (11) from GGPP in N. benthamiana. A) 13-gene set (Group 1), 14-gene set
(Group 2) and 13-gene set (Group 3) pathways for de novo biosynthesis of baccatin III and baccatin IV/VI from GGPP, respectively. B) HPLC-MS
extracted ion chromatograms (EICs) of plant extracts where GGPP is fed into N. benthamiana leaves expressing diﬀerent gene combinations of
paclitaxel biosynthesis to examine baccatin III (10), IV (1a), VI (11), 1-dehydroxybaccatin IV (1), and 1-dehydroxybaccatin VI (12) pathways. TXS:
taxadiene synthase (U48796); T2αH: taxane C2α-hydroxylase (AY518383); T5αH: taxane C5α-hydroxylase (AY741375); T7βH: taxane C7β-hydroxylase
(AY307951); T9αH: taxane C9α-hydroxylase (PP197199); T10βH: taxane C10β-hydroxylase (AF318211); T13αH: taxane C13α-hydroxylase (AY056019);
TOT: taxane oxetanase (OR921170); T5AT: taxane C5-O-acetyltransferase (also known as TAT, AF190130); T10AT: taxane C10-O-acetyltransferase (also
known as DBAT, AF193765); T2BT: taxane C2-O-benzoyltransferase (also known as TBT, AF297618); T9Ox: taxane C9-O-oxidase (oxidation of the
C9-hydroxy to the corresponding carbonyl); T7AT: taxane C7-O-acetyltransferase (PP197202); T13AT: taxane C13-O-acetyltransferase (AY628434). The
gray square indicates that the corresponding gene is not involved in the gene set.
